source.title: Palette-Based Color Transfer for Images and Videos
source.authors: Yue Zhao, Xiaowu Chen, Changbo Wang, et al.
source.venue: Journal of Computer Science and Technology 40(5), 2025

scope.included: automatic global palette transfer after palettes and transport T are fixed
excluded: video palette interpolation beyond the per-frame fixed affine observation

orientation.description: standard RGB tetrahedron with a valid red/blue permutation transport

range.description: source tetrahedron spanning [0.4,0.6] mapped to the standard RGB tetrahedron

forbidden_actions: reimplement palette extraction or optimization as a capacity rescue
apply the method to project or film images
call a reference-conditioned affine mapping a film or stock operator
claim the interactive local path is affine-only without a separate audit
claim_ceiling: analytic and synthetic evidence about the automatic global path for fixed palettes and transport only; no claim about interactive local editing, real-image quality, film, stock, calibration or unpaired operator identification
